"""归档第64轮独立采集与离线分析原件，并逐成员回读校验。"""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / 'knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm'
target = DATA / 'v67-diagnostic-artifacts.zip'
manifest = DATA / 'v67-archive-manifest.json'
assert not target.exists() and not manifest.exists()
analysis = json.loads((DATA / 'v67-analysis.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert analysis['completed'] is True
build = ROOT / '.tools/v67-diagnostic'
oracle = ROOT / '.tools/v67-offline-oracles'
files = sorted(set(p for p in build.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.suffix in ('.json', '.bin', '.cpp', '.txt', '.d')) |
               set(p for p in (build / 'captures').iterdir() if p.is_file()) |
               set(p for p in oracle.rglob('*') if p.is_file()))
members = {}
with zipfile.ZipFile(target, 'x', compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6) as z:
    for path in files:
        assert path.resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT)
        name = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        content = path.read_bytes()
        members[name] = {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(), 'bytes': len(content)}
        z.writestr(name, content)
with zipfile.ZipFile(target) as z:
    assert set(z.namelist()) == set(members) and len(z.namelist()) == len(members)
    for name, identity in members.items():
        content = z.read(name)
        assert hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() == identity['sha256'] and len(content) == identity['bytes']
source = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
record = {'passed': True, 'created_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'archive': target.name, 'archive_sha256': hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          'archive_bytes': target.stat().st_size, 'members': members,
          'source': source.decode('utf-8'), 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),
          'excludes': ['独立exe及obj；其身份和命令由build-manifest记录', 'v66冻结来源包已单独存在'],
          'solver_runs': 0}
with manifest.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(record, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'passed': True, 'members': len(members), 'archive_bytes': record['archive_bytes'], 'solver_runs': 0}))

"""保留第64轮每次调用的真实开始时间、退出、原始输出和执行源码。"""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / 'knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm'
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('label')
parser.add_argument('script')
parser.add_argument('arguments', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
args = parser.parse_args()
assert args.label.startswith('v67-') and '/' not in args.label and '\\' not in args.label
target = DATA / (args.label + '.json')
assert not target.exists()
script = (ROOT / args.script).resolve()
assert script.is_relative_to(ROOT) and script.is_file()
source = script.read_bytes()
command = [sys.executable, str(script), *args.arguments]
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
begin = time.perf_counter()
process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONUTF8='1'), capture_output=True)
record = {
    'started_at_utc': started,
    'completed_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'command': command, 'returncode': process.returncode, 'elapsed_seconds': time.perf_counter()-begin,
    'source': source.decode('utf-8'), 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),
    'stdout': process.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'),
    'stderr': process.stderr.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'),
    'wrapper_source': Path(__file__).read_bytes().decode('utf-8'),
    'wrapper_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
}
with target.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(record, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
    f.write('\n')
if process.returncode == 0 and args.arguments in (['self-test'], ['--self-test']) and script.name == 'v67-run.py':
    result = json.loads(record['stdout'])
    assert result['passed'] is True and result['lp_runs'] == 0
    with (DATA / 'v67-runner-self-check.json').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'record': str(target), 'returncode': record['returncode'],
                  'elapsed_seconds': record['elapsed_seconds']}, ensure_ascii=False))
print(record['stdout'][-4000:])
if record['stderr']:
    print(record['stderr'][-4000:])
raise SystemExit(process.returncode)
